caption: The drawing consists of four rectangular panels, each featuring a different geometric or abstract pattern. The top rectangle contains a repeating design with prominent scalloped brown forms, vertical striped borders in brown and white, alongside winding green and white lines with red backgrounds filling the spaces. The left rectangle in the second row alternates vertical brown and beige bands with intricate beige patterns, intersected by two horizontal dark blue bands. Beside it, the right rectangle contains a brown background with repeated whitish wavy lines alternating with blue diamond shapes. The bottom rectangle features a series of vertical brown stripes bordered by thin blue and gold lines, with two diamond shapes outlined in beige and blue, all set against a brown background. The artist's signature, "Albert Loran," appears in the bottom right corner of the page. The overall color palette includes brown, blue, green, red, beige, and white, with each pattern occupying a separate space on a plain off-white background.
title: Printed Cottons (from Quilt)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
